practice.title: STUDIO // PRACTICE
practice.practiceText: darkmode.id is an independent software engineering and information design practice. We engineer complex systems, low-latency tactile interfaces, and high-reliability operational infrastructure.
practice.leadershipText: Founded and led by Felipe Teles (Technical Lead). Purely technical dialogue, data-driven decisions, and direct execution from architecture to code in production.

principles.title: Data-Pixel & Density
principles.text: Systematic elimination of chartjunk and prioritization of informational clarity (Edward Tufte).

principles.title: Optical Ergonomics
principles.text: OLED-safe surface at #0A0B0D for black smearing mitigation and APCA contrast.

principles.title: Performance Budget
principles.text: Strict production Core Web Vitals targets (LCP < 1.2s, CLS = 0, INP < 50ms).

principles.title: Data Integrity
principles.text: Structural determinism, fully auditable pipelines, and GDPR/LGPD compliance.
